options.blogdescription: A temporary forum for trying bbPress

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

wp_set_current_user( 1 );

$forum_id = bbp_insert_forum( array(
	'post_title'   => 'bbPress Playground',
	'post_name'    => 'bbpress-playground',
	'post_content' => 'This temporary forum is yours to explore. Open the sample topic below, or create a topic of your own.',
) );

$topic_id = bbp_insert_topic( array(
	'post_parent'  => $forum_id,
	'post_title'   => 'Welcome to bbPress',
	'post_content' => 'This sample topic was created by the bbPress Playground preview. Try replying below.',
), array(
	'forum_id' => $forum_id,
) );

$reply_id = bbp_insert_reply( array(
	'post_parent'  => $topic_id,
	'post_title'   => 'Re: Welcome to bbPress',
	'post_content' => 'Everything in this site is temporary, so feel free to experiment.',
), array(
	'forum_id' => $forum_id,
	'topic_id' => $topic_id,
) );

if ( empty( $forum_id ) || empty( $topic_id ) || empty( $reply_id ) ) {
	throw new RuntimeException( 'Unable to create the bbPress Playground content.' );
}

if ( 1 !== bbp_get_forum_topic_count( $forum_id, true, true ) || 1 !== bbp_get_topic_reply_count( $topic_id, true ) ) {
	throw new RuntimeException( 'The bbPress Playground content counts are incorrect.' );
}

flush_rewrite_rules();
